captured_on.note: The last machine the environment was captured on. check_env.py reports the live OS beside it; a different OS is a warning, not a failure.

ardupilot.note: The checkout at src/ardupilot is pinned to `commit`. The parent repository's recorded gitlink differs (uncommitted submodule move); check_env.py reports both and pins to `commit`.

python.note: MAVProxy is a hard import of Tools/autotest/vehicle_test_suite.py, so a cell cannot be flown without it; check_env.py fails on its absence except under --dry-run. It was not installed on the capture machine (the dry run was).

location.name: CMAC
location.note: ArduPilot's default SITL site. The local frame is anchored at the aircraft when the window opens (HANC), so the absolute site does not enter any result. A real flight-area location must not be committed (AGENTS.md); supply one through --location if wanted and it is recorded in provenance only.
